facts.text: If you're looking for a big winner in 2027, you'll likely need to widen your search beyond Bitcoin and Ethereum .
In bull market cycles, these two cryptocurrencies perform well, of course, but nowhere near as well as more speculative altcoins with much smaller market caps.
Yahoo Finance is not a broker-dealer or investment adviser and does not offer securities or cryptocurrencies for sale or facilitate trading.
This is not to say that Cardano will 10x in 2027.
But I wouldn't be surprised at all if it climbs back past the $1 mark.
As recently as January 2025, Cardano traded for $1.
That's nearly a 5x return, and much higher than Bitcoin or Ethereum is projected to return.
Just five years ago, Cardano ranked as the fourth-largest cryptocurrency on the planet, trailing only Bitcoin, Ethereum, and BNB .
In 2027, there is one type of altcoin that I'm expecting to perform particularly well: beaten-down cryptocurrencies that have pretty much been left for dead in 2026.
With that in mind, there's one name that I've already circled for a potential major rebound next year: Cardano (CRYPTO: ADA).
Dominic Basulto has positions in Bitcoin, Cardano, Ethereum, and Solana.
The Motley Fool has positions in and recommends Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana.

Wall Street's biggest settlement firm just named Stellar as a future partner, sending XLM back onto traders' watchlists.
But before you chase the catalyst, the comparison with Ethereum reveals some uncomfortable truths about timing, tokenization dominance, and price reality.
Sam Daodu is a crypto analyst who's spent nearly a decade making blockchain understandable—no easy task when most whitepapers read like fever dreams.
He writes for 24/7 Wall St., covering Bitcoin, altcoins, and crypto market analysis for investors.
Before crypto, he was a tech writer (back when explaining "the cloud" was peak innovation).
Since 2018, he's written for CoinTelegraph, Yahoo Finance, The Block, Cryptonews, Zypto, Rain, and more—basically anywhere people want crypto news without the headache.
Sam runs MacLabs Marketing, a content agency for crypto brands tired of sounding like AI wrote their website.
He also publishes free crypto education on his site for Web3 enthusiasts who think "gas fees" is a typo.

When he's not writing or staring at charts, Sam's either: - Watching anime (currently convinced One Piece has better tokenomics than most altcoins) - At the gym sculpting himself into a Greek god - Listening to the music your mum warned you only bad boys listen to Connect: LinkedIn | Email | MacLabs Marketing
Technically, XLM must first recover to $0.20, roughly 12% above its current price and a level it held on October 10.
If DTCC postpones Stellar’s launch, XLM may lose its latest catalyst and keep trailing Ethereum as it has over the past 90 days.
Conversely, if DTCC announces a 2027 launch date for Stellar and XLM closes above $0.20, it could create a significant opportunity for XLM to make up ground.
In the XLM vs Ethereum comparison, Ethereum stands as the more reliable choice for investors interested in tokenization.
Investors considering XLM face significant risk from a potential DTCC catalyst that is still a year away and could change.

The Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC), a major player in settling U.S. stock trades, expects Stellar ( CRYPTO:XLM ) to join its upcoming Tokenization Service in 2027, according to its roadmap.
Tokenization converts stocks and bonds into digital tokens that can be traded on a blockchain.
Stellar will not be part of the October launch, and DTCC has not confirmed a specific date for its entry.
Ethereum significantly outpaces Stellar in tokenized assets, with $17 billion in tokenized RWAs and $147.1 billion in stablecoins.
However, Ethereum has already attracted substantial institutional investment that Stellar still needs to secure.
XLM is trading at approximately $0.18, down 0.6% in the last 24 hours.
